title: Manual reader and guide catalog
summary: Shared Players/Creators navigation over documents and explicit trusted live-content adapters.

blocks.text: ui.manual@1.0.0 depends on ui.window-content@^1.0.0. It owns a removable guide catalog and independent reader instances. Each instance receives its book, root, optional preference storage and unique DOM ID prefix. It has no simulation, pilot, input or tutorial dependency.

Register structured document pages with stable IDs, title, summary and Players/Creators audience. Search includes contributed body text. Registration returns a lease; removing it refreshes readers and falls back to an available page. For staged replacement, register(pages, {replace: true}) temporarily shadows matching guide IDs: releasing the candidate restores the prior guides, while releasing the prior lease keeps the new guides. Duplicate IDs within one registration always fail. guides(audience) keeps contributed data discoverable by recovery/library UI without mounting a reader. Candidate guide assets remain owned by their host; no raw imported HTML is accepted as a document.

For trusted live content, the host can provide a mount callback and a revision string. The game adapter owns input interpretation and template expansion; refresh updates the body only when the page or revision changes, preserving scroll and expanded explanations during chrome changes. The default Space Sim book is editable in modules/manual/src/content.ts and composed through apps/web/src/manual-content.ts; the app expands live keybindings when mounting it. The reader does not run tutorials.

The provider owns reader instances and injected styles; each reader owns listeners, document mounts and navigation state. Dispose aborts handlers, removes reading resources and restores borrowed root children/classes. Factories reject creation after disposal. Storage failures leave navigation usable for the session. Use a separate idPrefix and storageKey for independent readers; live controls can be omitted.
